subtopics.title: The Taxi Rank Reality (What is Inflation?)

questions.question: What is the economic term for a sustained and significant increase in the general price level of goods and services?
When inflation occurs, what happens to the purchasing power of your money?
options: It only affects taxi fares, not other goods.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the 'general price level' mentioned in the definition of inflation?
options: The average price of a wide variety of goods and services moving up together.
A temporary weekend special on groceries.
The price of a single specific item, like petrol.
The value of the Rand compared to the US Dollar.

subtopics.title: The Spaza Shop Basket (The Consumer Price Index - CPI)

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'basket of goods' used to calculate the CPI?
options: To represent the typical goods and services bought by an average household.
To track the prices of only the most expensive luxury items.
To measure the total output of factories in the country.
To count how many items a single spaza shop sells in a day.

questions.question: If the base year for the CPI is set at an index number of 100, and the current year's index number is 108, what does this indicate?
options: The price of the basket of goods has increased.
The price of the basket of goods has decreased.
The country is experiencing a recession.

subtopics.title: The Math on the Streets (Calculating Inflation Rate)

questions.question: What is the correct formula to calculate the inflation rate using the CPI?
If the CPI rises from 110 to 121, what is the inflation rate?
A student calculates the inflation rate and gets 0.06 as the final answer before multiplying by 100. What is the actual inflation rate?
